title: Home practical guide and safety card: the soil shake test
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Soils and aquatic plants (Flow and One Planet, Our World)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 26 (Home practical guide and safety card: the soil shake test (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 26: Soil in a jar: the shake test. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see the different layers in soil
equipment: A clear jar with a lid
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put soil in the jar until it is a quarter full
Fill the jar almost to the top with water
An adult checks the lid is tight
Shake the jar for one minute
Leave it still for a day
Draw the layers you see: stones at the bottom, then sand, silt and clay, with bits floating on top

questions.q: Big question: what would you see in the jar in the morning?
questions.a: Layers: stones at the bottom, sand, then silt and clay, clearer water, humus floating.
